title: Carbon-fiber array · direct vagus recording
citation: Jiman, A., Ratze, D., Welle, E., Patel, P., Bottorff, E., Richie, J., Seymour, J., Chestek, C., & Bruns, T. (2021). Intraneural recordings in rat vagus nerves using carbon fiber microelectrode arrays (Version 1, revision 2). SPARC. doi:10.26275/j5wc-rwcr.
processing: Two 100ms NSx excerpts at 10s and 20s from EN_0003. Four acquisition channels retained. Native int16 values linearly scaled to µV using each NSx channel header; no added filtering, averaging, baseline subtraction, spike sorting or decimation. Acquisition header specifies 0.3Hz high-pass and 7500Hz low-pass.

provenance.subject: sub-01-EN
provenance.selection: Fixed 10.0–10.1s and20.0–20.1s intervals; acquisition channels2,10,18,26. Intervals selected without screening for spike yield.
provenance.channelMap: Acquisition channel IDs retained. Dataset supplies a Grapevine-to-CFMA connector map, but this viewer does not claim contact-by-contact mapping to the cortical device model.
provenance.scaling: µV = digitalCount × (maxAnalog−minAnalog)/(maxDigital−minDigital) + minAnalog − minDigital×scale. Header values: digital±32767, analog±8191µV.

limitations: These are rat vagus-nerve recordings from the Michigan carbon-fiber research family; the catalog sheet describes separate cortical configurations.
Continuous extracellular voltage contains noise and possible non-neural artifacts; no identified single units or spike labels are inferred here.
Only four acquisition channels and two short fixed intervals are shown; the full dataset has additional channels, conditions and subjects.
No source stimulation or movement events were assigned to these excerpts.
Byte-range hashes are retained, but the full578MB source file SHA256 was not verified because the file was not downloaded in full.
